title: Stable but Hidden: Identifiability and Experimental Design under Missing Compositional Support
abstract: arXiv:2611.30070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-guided scientific discovery often uses inexpensive predictors to allocate scarce verification measurements. We study a structural failure when relevant components have been observed separately but never jointly: distinct admissible response functions can agree on all observed compositions while disagreeing on the missing combinations. Additional same-support data cannot resolve this ambiguity, and agreement among fitted models need not expose it.   We characterize the unresolved directions as an invisible subspace $\mathcal{N}_T(\mathcal{F}) = \ker \mathcal{R}_T$, whose geometry determines oracle zero-shot ambiguity and minimax risk under a symmetric, bounded ambiguity class. When the missing response lies in an $r$-dimensional, well-conditioned linear basis, optimally designed joint measurements achieve minimax integrated risk $\Theta(\sigma^2 r/m)$, with classical $I$-optimality the fixed-design criterion.   We validate on materials

translated_title: 稳定却隐蔽：缺失组合支撑下的可辨识性与实验设计
translated_abstract: AI引导的科学发现常常使用廉价的预测器来分配稀缺的验证测量资源。我们研究了当相关组分曾被分别观测、但从未被联合观测时出现的一种结构性失效：不同的可容许响应函数可以在所有已观测的组合上一致，却在缺失的组合上产生分歧。额外的同支撑域数据无法消除这种歧义，而且拟合模型之间的一致性也未必能暴露这种歧义。我们将这些未被解决的方向刻画为一个不可见子空间 $\mathcal{N}_T(\mathcal{F}) = \ker \mathcal{R}_T$，其几何结构决定了oracle零样本歧义度以及在对称有界歧义类下的极小极大风险。当缺失的响应位于一个r维、条件良好的线性基中时，经过最优设计的联合测量可以达到极小极大积分风险 $\Theta(\sigma^2 r/m)$，其中经典的I-最优性即为固定设计准则。我们在材料领域进行了验证。
tldr: 该论文揭示了当相关组分只被分别观测而从未被联合观测时存在一个不可辨识的“不可见子空间”盲区，并证明通过最优设计的联合测量可将极小极大积分风险降低至 $\Theta(\sigma^2 r/m)$。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals an "invisible subspace" of non-identifiability that arises when relevant components are observed separately but never jointly, and shows that optimally designed joint measurements attain minimax integrated risk $\Theta(\sigma^2 r/m)$.
